body:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Touches dependencies (`package.json` `patchedDependencies`, `bun.lock`) and ships third-party native C code (`patches/uiohook-napi@1.5.5.patch`, 180 lines of `uiohook_worker.c` from SnosMe/uiohook-napi#66) that runs on the Electron main thread; a mistake there is a hang or a crash in every recording. Also edits `scripts/rebuild-native.sh` comments (CI calls that script).

Head under review: 187ff2fb (patch-id efec6747). Base: main (75ace2ae). Budget: 5 rounds (high risk). Round 1: Opus reviewer subagent.

| id | severity | file | claim | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | should | scripts/setup-dev.sh, scripts/rebuild-native.sh, release-desktop.yml | stamp only compares Electron version; stale/unpatched build reads as current after the patch lands | fixed: scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh (Electron + patch hash) used by rebuild, setup-dev and the release check — commit (round-1 fixes) |
| S2 | nit | patches/uiohook-napi@1.5.5.patch | FINISHED+SUCCESS (hook_run returns before the waiter wakes) is reported as success for a dead thread | declined: patch stays verbatim upstream (settled); raise on PR #66 as follow-up; unreachable in this app on macOS |
| S3 | nit | click-hook-native-patch.test.ts | trylock assertion scanned added lines only and could never fail | fixed: asserts on installed uiohook_worker.c (predicate loop present, hook_running_mutex absent) — same commit |
| S4 | nit | setup-dev.sh, pr-checks.yml, release-desktop.yml | stale "no clicks"/"wrong ABI" claims remained | fixed: same commit |
| S5 | nit | patches/*.patch on CRLF checkouts | Windows checkout could alter the patch bytes and fail --frozen-lockfile | fixed: .gitattributes `patches/*.patch -text` — same commit; Windows job still unverified until the release workflow runs |
| S6 | nit | libuiohook darwin input_hook.c:280 | pre-existing stop-side hang: key press during stop() dispatch_syncs to a main thread blocked in uv_thread_join | declined here: pre-existing; added as motivating case to the utilityProcess-isolation follow-up ticket |
| S7 | should | scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh | absolute MSYS path inside a JS string breaks `node -p` on Git Bash; build-win would die after compiling | fixed: cwd-relative require inside one node call — commit (round-2 fixes) |
| S8 | should | scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh | with no patches, `cat $(...)` read stdin: setup/rebuild hang in a terminal | fixed: files enumerated in node, `patches-none` when empty; verified with stdin held open — same commit |
| S9 | nit | scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh | `shasum` not guaranteed on Git Bash | fixed: hash computed with node:crypto — same commit |
| S10 | nit | apps/kaipu-record/scripts/build-mac-local.sh | stale "wrong ABI" claim | fixed — same commit |
| S11 | nit | windows-release-design.md, rebuild-native.sh comment | stamp description and caller list outdated | fixed — same commit |
| S12 | nit | scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh | hashes repo patches, not installed sources: editing a patch and rebuilding without `bun install` stamps old sources as current | declined: bun.lock pins the patch hash and `bun install` is the step that applies it; follow-up if it ever bites |
Round 2 (Opus): S1–S6 resolved/accepted; S7–S12 above. Round 3 (Opus): S7–S9 re-check on the rewritten script only.
| S13 | nit | scripts/native-deps-stamp.sh:18 | with CDPATH exported, `cd scripts/..` may print a path into the captured stamp | declined: pre-existing pattern (old ROOT= line had it), only bites with an exported CDPATH; follow-up: `CDPATH= cd -- …` |
Round 3 (Opus): APPROVE; S7–S11 resolved, S13 nit declined. Awaiting Codex (cross-provider round).
Cross-provider round (Codex CLI 0.154.0): NOT RUN. The account's configured model (`gpt-6.1-sol`) and four fallbacks (gpt-6-codex, gpt-5.5-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5-codex) were rejected with `model_not_found` for a ChatGPT account. This is not a pass; the owner can rerun `codex review --base main` once the model is fixed in ~/.codex/config.toml.

**Verdict for b79f83aa (patch-id fb812e61, the whole PR diff vs main): approved by the independent reviewer, only nits remain.** Rounds used: 3 of 5 (Opus 4 round 1 full diff; Opus round 2 open ids + new code; Opus round 3 stamp script only). The cross-provider round did **not** run (see above), so for a high-risk PR this is one provider's approval, not the full gate: the PR stays open for the owner to merge. Any push or rebase after b79f83aa voids this verdict (compare `git diff main...HEAD | git patch-id --stable`).

Declined nits, listed as follow-ups: S2 (raise FINISHED+SUCCESS upstream), S6 (stop-side hang → utilityProcess ticket), S12 (stamp hashes repo patches, not installed sources), S13 (`CDPATH= cd --`).

---

**Update after the bot review (push d6346e5c).** Bot thread on the test → accepted in part: the macOS release job now runs the same stamp check as Windows (`ci(release): verify the native stamp on the macOS job too`). Bot thread on the stamp file name → declined as a follow-up (rename to `.native-deps-stamp` with the next change to these scripts).

| id | severity | file | claim | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S14 | nit | release-desktop.yml:127 / :263 | the stamp-check step is duplicated in build-mac and build-win and can drift | declined: follow-up, extract to `scripts/check-native-stamp.sh` when either copy next changes |

**Verdict for d6346e5c (patch-id d6612307, whole PR diff vs main): approved by the independent reviewer (Opus, round 4 on the YAML change only); only nits remain.** Rounds used: 4 of 5. Cross-provider round not run (Codex: configured model rejected by the account). High risk → the owner merges. A push or rebase after d6346e5c voids this verdict.

Note on CI: per ADR 0027 a non-release PR runs only the classifier and the agent review here (build, lint, unit and E2E jobs show as "skipping" by design). The unit suite, type-check, lint, format and workflow checks were run locally on this head (see Checks); the Windows build of the patched sources happens on the next release workflow.
